notes: Hyper-parameter q=4 (probability of Type II feedback to false-label classes in the multi-output CoTM) used for CelebA; Fig. 11 compares q=1/4/7 over ~30 epochs (precision/recall/accuracy, data split not stated) - the figure's x-axis suggests about 30 training epochs but the final model's epoch count is not stated. A hyper-parameter search was performed for CelebA, but the paper does not say on which data, so selection_on_test is not_reported. CelebA subset size, train/test split and how the subset was balanced are not given. Table III metrics are the average of the per-class metrics (macro); AUROC/AUPRC use P=(1+v/T)/2 (Eq. 6). Thermometer bits per channel are ambiguous: 8 levels with the paper's Eq. 5 (B values -> B-1 bits) would be 7 bits, so bits_per_feature is left not_reported. The selected attributes are marked in Fig. 5 by bar colour (not visible in the text); the names come from Fig. 7/9 labels. No std or number of runs reported. Implementation (tmu or other) not named.
